title: Compact Decision View
description: The layer-3 information view of a scientific record (03-storage-and-authority.md section 2): a short decision-oriented markdown summary authored by the same role that produces the primary artifact. The record references this output through a representations[] entry whose artifact uri is output://<this file name>; the harness stamps the real artifact pointer at closure.

title.description: Short display title of the view, e.g. 'Literature synthesis - compact view'.

summary_markdown.description: Decision-oriented markdown. P1 synthesis: 1-2 paragraphs - what the literature establishes, what is missing, what the next phase should try. P3 theory: 1-2 pages - the result statements, core proof idea, and assumptions that matter downstream.
